messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High 503 rate (avg 18%) from inference-edge in eu-west-2 during deploy. Trigger: canary traffic. Alerts: +error-rate +deploy. Incident link: https://redwood/status/3112223344
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started at 2026-03-15T01:20:00Z -> variant=v2-edge-proxy 10% traffic. Automatic rollback disabled for this canary.
Sara N.: seeing spikes on the dashboards, reproducing locally with short seqs. Logs show repeated upstream connection resets.
Devon L.: I can patch routing, but need context — did we change proxy timeouts in this deploy? @Mikael do you know?
Mikael: No timeout change in proxy config from my PR. I deployed an edge route rewrite for the model switch. Rolling back that rewrite now.
Olivia K.: Confirmed clients (region eu-west-2) see 503s when requests route to /v2/edge-gen. Some backends return 200 but proxy returns 503 with `upstream connect error`.
Priya S.: Customer support: multiple customers reported failures in embeddings and small LLM calls, impact roughly 7 enterprise tenants — ticketing underway. Prioritize rollback.
SRE Oncall: Can we flip the canary to 0% immediately? Which flag controls it?
Sara N.: The rollout uses fflag `edge_v2_canary_pct`. I can set it to 0 via admin-console but want a coordinated rollback if other changes happened.
Devon L.: I'll run the kill switch from the control plane: `redwood ffctl set edge_v2_canary_pct 0 --env eu-west-2`
Devon L.: running now...
deploy-bot: Command accepted. Proposed change: edge_v2_canary_pct: 10 -> 0. ETA for propagation 15s.
Incident Bot: Change propagated to routing layer. Observability: snapshot: 30s post-change.
Sara N.: dashboards show immediate drop in 503s to baseline ~1.2% after flip. Great.
Mikael: ack. I'm going to roll the canary back entirely (revert the route rewrite) and monitor for slow drains. Rolling revert PR: `git revert -m 1 d4c3b2`.
Olivia K.: Noting customer impact: embeddings retries caused queue spikes. Support message template drafted: "We experienced a partial service disruption in EU affecting inference requests; services restored after rollback; no data loss."
Priya S.: Sending to customers now, include status page link.
SRE Oncall: Logging timeline and actions in postmortem stub: cause = route-rewrite + unexpected edge proxy interaction; mitigation = kill-switch -> revert rewrite -> bump proxy health probe.
Devon L.: I pushed the revert and kicked a staged deploy back to previous canary config. Watching tail of access logs:
```
[2026-03-15T01:21:34Z] proxy[euw2] upstream_connect_error route=/v2/edge-gen upstream=10.2.3.45:5043
[2026-03-15T01:21:35Z] proxy[euw2] 503 served_count=124 canary_pct=10
```
Sara N.: After rollback logs show connection resets stopped and 200s resumed.
Mikael: Suggest adding a safety net: make canary caps default 5% unless explicitly bumped and enable auto-rollback on sustained 5-min error >5%. Filing infra ticket.
SRE Oncall: Agreed. For now, set a short-term mitigation: increase proxy upstream connection timeout to 10s and add clearer health-check for the route.
Devon L.: Done for eu-west-2 in staging; will schedule prod change during low traffic window unless urgent.
Incident Bot: Incident status -> RESOLVED (mitigated) | Symptoms: high 503s in eu-west-2 | Root cause: route rewrite + proxy behavior on canary | Mitigation: fflag kill-switch, revert PR, adjust upstream timeouts | Postmortem: assigned to @Mikael.
Olivia K.: I'll follow up with CSM for impacted customers; update weekly SLA incident summary.
Priya S.: Closing the open support tickets as "service restored" and asking customers to reopen if they see further errors.
SRE Oncall: Handoff to day SRE team for follow-up. I'll attach graphs and raw logs to the incident ticket.
Sara N.: Thanks all. Quick retrospective item: test route rewrites against a real proxy in staging (full e2e) before canary ramp.
Mikael: Will own the postmortem and remediation plan.
Devon L.: cc @product-support for any rollout process changes.
Incident Bot: Note: Pager closed at 2026-03-15T01:24:00Z.
